dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior end, following a smooth parabolic curve.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical indentation visible on the lower left edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-contrast, fine-grained dark pixel clusters distributed across the dorsal surface, increasing in density toward the lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; no sharp boundaries between localized pigmentation variations and the primary baseline tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single small, high-contrast dark spot is visible on the posterior right quadrant of the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, distinct dark mark is present on the right side of the posterior dorsal area.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent, high-contrast dark circular blowhole located at the anterior dorsal apex.
